# chameleon_catalog_roles (Data Source)

List all catalog roles defined within a catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_catalog_roles" "all" {
  catalog = "analytics"
}

output "analytics_catalog_roles" {
  value = data.chameleon_catalog_roles.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog (warehouse) name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Catalog role names.
